description: Introduces categories through objects, arrows, composition, and identities, showing how the same laws describe functions, orders, paths, and other kinds of mathematical structure.

recommended.reason: Optional review of functions, composition and equality of maps.

background: Sets and functions as rules between collections; familiarity with composing functions is helpful.
readiness_checks: Can you compose two functions with compatible domains and codomains?
Can you explain why an identity function changes no input?
